scope_note: Items 1 (tick imbalance) and 4 (micro continuation/reversal) were already run in Phase-2 R1 as A1/A2 (COST_INSUFFICIENT). They are RE-RUN here under this frozen protocol for reproducibility, and the agreement is reported. Items 2 and 3 are new.

data.volume_status: DATA_GAP - volume/volume_real/last identically 0 => every flow feature is a quote-based _PROXY
data.execution_reference: FXTM demo tick bid/ask (magic 90004 account); DUKA is NOT used

components.spread: MEASURED (0.18bp at calibration; snapshot median 0.34bp full spread)
components.slippage: MEASURED distribution from the 19-RT pilot; SIGNED, only the unfavorable leg counts
components.latency_cost: MEASURED (entry signal->fill median ~272ms) - not added as bp, reported separately
components.adverse_selection: MEASURED as the execution markout itself, not double-charged

execution_model.entry: first tick with ts > signal tick ts; long at ask, short at bid
execution_model.exit: mid at the first tick with ts >= entry_ts + h; HORIZON_CENSORED excluded when crossing a segment break (>60s gap) or the sample end

frozen_thresholds.a_priori: thresholds reused from the prior frozen rounds (|z|>=2, trailing-quantile regimes); NO scan, NO tuning

hypotheses.feature: TI_PROXY = sum(sign(dmid), trailing 100 ticks)/sqrt(100)  [_PROXY: no size data]
hypotheses.entry: next tick after the trigger tick
hypotheses.comparison: re-run of Phase-2 R1 A1_TICKIMB_CONT (reproducibility check)

hypotheses.feature: impact shock = |z(dmid over trailing 500 ticks)| >= 2 vs trailing 3000-tick std; reversion target = the mid at shock onset
hypotheses.mechanism: after a price impact, liquidity replenishes and the mid recovers toward the pre-shock level
hypotheses.extra: coefficient = recovered fraction (how much of the shock is given back by h), reported per spread regime

hypotheses.feature: spread at shock onset vs trailing 3000-tick median
hypotheses.metric: time (ms) until spread_bp returns within 10% of the trailing median; and the same conditioned on wide/normal spread at onset

hypotheses.feature: joint cell = (spread tertile TIGHT/MID/WIDE from trailing q33/q67) x (rv500 tertile LOW/MID/HIGH) x (pressure sign of TI_PROXY)
hypotheses.mechanism: the JOINT state carries information the marginals do not (interaction), i.e. a conditional drift
hypotheses.trigger: the pressure sign is non-zero; entry on the tick at which the joint cell label is evaluated (every 500 ticks, deterministic grid to avoid overlapping spam)
hypotheses.multiple_testing: 18 cells x 6 horizons; Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at 0.05 reported alongside the ladder

hypotheses.feature: micro impulse = ret over trailing 100 ticks
hypotheses.comparison: closest prior = Phase-2 R1 C2_ARRIVAL_BURST_CONT (different trigger, same direction class)

validation.bootstrap: block bootstrap over events, n=2000, blocks=50
validation.overlap_check: report raw event n, overlap ratio at each horizon, and effective_n = greedy non-overlapping event count
validation.VALIDATED_EDGE_requires: cost-adjusted gross > 0 at 1x on IS AND OOS, permutation p<0.05, bootstrap CI excludes 0, effective_n>=30, survives 2x cost, stable across sub-segments
validation.direction_policy: every directional source frozen BOTH ways
